notes.title: HUGE UPDATE IS HERE
notes.content:
Hello, the ones who born in Umbra. 

We are glad to announce that the update is now in the game and you can enjoy the innovations that the new version of the game will offer.

There were a bunch of big and small fixes and additions, in addition, the game switched to a new engine and now uses new lighting. 

The game also contains some gameplay changes.

Okay, here we go. 

- Changed the way you progress through the game. 
- New abilities 
- New music
- New enemies 
- New gameplay mechanics
- New sounds
- New animations
- Added support for the monitors with high refresh rate, up to 165 hz. 
- Added German, Chinese, French and Russian languages
- Fixed annoying bug with unability for some players to get the achievment

Hope you like new update, if you would like to discuss update or report bugs please let  us know.

notes.title: Changes incoming
notes.content:
Changes are coming

It was hard to work on this game, for the simple reason that it was made a long time ago, and a lot has changed since then. In addition, for some reason, some references and parent classes refused to work (perhaps due to a change in the engine), so they had to be rewritten.

Thus, the game switched to a new engine, received new lighting, skills were changed, as well as core gameplay, while not losing its essence. New enemies, new effects, new game mechanics, new animations, and more have been added that will hopefully be a pleasant surprise for hardcore fans of the game.

https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExY2Y1YWQxODc5OWJkYWQwM2Y5NTQxNWY3ZmQ2YWE3ODE4NDhkMzk3YyZjdD1n/BeP6CpOSl4sef8VWfj/giphy.gif

Thus, the update, which includes all the innovations and fixes many small annoying bugs, will be released within the next two weeks. Stay tunned, born in the Umbra.
